Happy with my purchase.

name: Laxmipriya sripada
text: I’ve been using Vyra Herbal Hair Oil for past 1 year The oil is light, non-sticky, and has a pleasant herbal smell After 2 weeks I noticed less hair fall while combing, and my scalp feels less dry and itchy. By week 5, I could see small baby hair around my hairline. It washes off easily with 1-2 shampoos and doesn’t leave the hair greasy. The only downside is that results take time. Don’t expect magic in 7 days. Overall, it’s a good natural option if you’re dealing with hair fall and dryness and want to avoid chemicals. Rating: 4.8/5. Will repurchase.
